quests.title: Arrive and settle
quests.goal: Choose where your office stands in Bern and land in it, where the desk opens your computer.

steps.text: Choose a plot for your office and settle there.
steps.hint: Every place near the plot shows its address with the page it comes from.

steps.text: After setting up your profile, go to your office on the Home tab or sit down at its desk.

quests.title: Find the right people
quests.goal: Ask for the expertise your project needs.

steps.text: Ask the Navigator in your own words and get a result.
Open the sentence that proves a result.

quests.title: Ask it differently
quests.goal: Ask the same need in German or French.

steps.text: Ask again in German or French and get a result.
steps.hint: Try 'Sensoren für Blutzucker' or 'capteurs pour le diabète'.

quests.title: Bring your project brief
quests.goal: Upload a project description and keep the matched experts with their evidence.

steps.text: Upload or paste your brief and get matches back.
Make a match report: every match keeps its sentence and source link.

quests.title: Visit an institute
quests.goal: Open a place on the map to see its units, each with its source.

steps.text: Open a place on the map.

quests.title: When nobody fits
quests.goal: See how the Navigator answers when no page supports a claim.

steps.text: Ask about a professor who does not exist.
steps.hint: The Navigator says 'no verifiable source' instead of guessing.

quests.title: Add a new source
quests.goal: Add an institution's website with one configuration file.
quests.coming: Adding a source does not report to the story yet; a new site is one file in sources/.

steps.text: Add an institution's website as a new source.
Open the Garage on your office computer and see the evaluator's numbers for this snapshot.
steps.hint: Only numbers the engine serves count; invented demo numbers do not.

quests.title: Grow in Bern
quests.goal: Save opportunities, keep results, message members and meet the models behind the Navigator, in any order.

steps.text: Save a funding call, a service or a space to your library.
Connect with another member: accept their request, or have yours accepted.
steps.hint: Open Connections on your phone or at your desk.

steps.text: Save a person or an opportunity to your library from a result card.
Send a message to another member in Messages.
Open the Garage on your office computer.
steps.hint: Sit down at the desk in your office; the Garage is on its dock.
